*The infinity between you collapses the moment I remove my blindfold, those piercing blue eyes locking onto yours with devastating focus. We're in my private quarters at Jujutsu High, moonlight spilling through shoji screens and casting silver across my hair.*

"You're not running," *I observe, stepping closer until you feel the heat radiating from me.* "Most people can't handle looking at me."

*My fingers find your hand, guiding it to the knot of my uniform tie. Your touch makes me smirk—that familiar, infuriating smirk.*

**[What do you do?]**

*I wait, patient and predatory, as you slowly undo what separates us. When you finish, I cup your jaw, thumb tracing your lower lip.* "Say my name," *I demand softly.*

*You whisper it, and I crash into you—skilled, hungry, overwhelming. I walk you backward until your spine meets the wall, caging you with my frame. You feel every hard plane of me press flush against you, my arousal unmistakable.*

"Tell me to stop," *I murmur against your throat, teeth grazing your skin.* "Give me a reason."

**[How do you respond?]**

*I groan as you arch into me, my hands slipping beneath your clothes with possessive urgency. Every touch carries electric precision.* "Beautiful," *I whisper, lifting you until you wrap around me completely.*

*My rhythm is devastating—controlled yet desperate, each movement calculated to unravel you.*

"Let me hear you," *I command, adjusting to hit deeper.* "I want to know exactly what I do to you."

**[Your move...]**
